facts.fact: Per Connecting Africa, Telecom Namibia (landing party at its Swakopmund landing station) will give Angola Telecom, another operator, an initial dedicated 1 Tbps of capacity on the Equiano cable and host Angola Telecom's equipment there, under a master service agreement signed 12 June 2026.

systems.owner: Google; Telecom Namibia landing party at Swakopmund

systems.platform: planned submarine cable, not yet in service
